title: OpenAI Astra new model explained..
description:
Zo Computer: https://zo-computer.cello.so/2XNkhpgqHRy

OpenAI Astra just solved 10 open problems in math and theoretical computer science for $2,000 at Sol's pricing

We are inching closer to AGI, but are we really? Math and physics is a narrow field when considering intelligence as whole. So how do we really process this news from OpenAI where their newest frontier model that is unreleased just demonstrated a novel solution even when LLMs have been criticized by many, notably Yann LeCun, as the inferior method towards AGI.

#openai #agi #technology
